title: ZeroClaw is a Rust rewrite of OpenClaw, The binary is 3MB and launches instantly

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: ZeroClaw is a rust rewrite of OpenClaw. The binary is 3 megabytes and launches instantly compared to a Node.js process that typically sits around 400 megabytes of RAM. Supports 22 AI providers including Claude, OpenAI, and Alama. Connects to Telegram and Discord out of the box. File system sandboxed with nullbite and sim link protection. Three autonomy levels read and supervised full. Deploy anywhere. Swap anything.
